//: The type-level test. Compiling this file IS the assertion: every
`@ts-expect-error` must really be an error (TypeScript reports an unused
directive as one), and every fixture in the accepted lists must type-check.
It emits, rather than `--noEmit`, because `tools/schema.test.mjs` then runs
the SAME fixtures through the runtime validator. That is what makes the two
halves one test: a value the type system allows must validate, and a value
the type system rejects must not.
